summary:
Sicey is a model router.

A sizing line is a stack of screens, coarsest at the top. Everything is tipped onto the first one, and what is too big to pass stays there while the rest falls through until a screen holds it. Nothing is sorted by hand and nothing is inspected twice.

Your models are the screens. Sicey grades every request by rules, not by asking another model to read your prompt first, and sends it down your own list: the hard ones stay on your best model, the easy ones fall to cheaper ones as its daily budget runs down. A conversation stays on the model it started on, because a prompt cache belongs to one model.

One API key for all of them. OpenAI and Anthropic clients both work on both endpoints, streaming included, even when the model answering speaks the other format. Every reply carries headers saying which model answered, where it sat on your ladder, what the request sized at and one sentence on why it landed there.

Sicey also runs its own models on its own hardware, which answer with no provider key at all and catch the work when everything else is spent. That is what this token pays for: burning it from your wallet turns into credit, and the Credits page prints what a million tokens is worth on the market right beside what burning a million gives you, so the comparison is on the page rather than left to you.
